text:
liz: Heads up — QBR prep item: finance wants to consolidate MDF pools across marketplace + SI co-sell for next quarter. Can we run a quick gating checklist before we propose the merged slab?

maria: On it. What constraints are non-negotiable from partnerships POV? eg: dedicated runway for strategic SIs, crate for marketplace promos? :thinking_face:

ton y: (cc @maria) we need to preserve at least 25% of MDF pool for premiere SI onboarding (training, proof-of-concept credits). Anything lower will slow adoption.

jamal: From finance: we can merge pools but need a clear reallocation rubric and month-by-month forecast. Please provide a sim that shows usage & projected burn for 6 months.

kevin: Sales asks that existing commitments to top-10 partners are honored. If merge reduces visible budget, we get pushback. Recommend we create a tagged sub-pool for legacy commitments.

liz: Agreed. Proposal outline: 1) Merge under single "MDF Pool A"; 2) Reserve 30% for legacy commitments + strategic SI runway; 3) 10% for marketplace promos; 4) remaining 60% dynamic. Thoughts? :thumbsup: / :thumbsdown:

maria: I like the reserve approach but prefer names: "Committed Legacy", "SI Onboard", "Marketplace Promo", "Open"]

partner-bot: Reminder — QBR deck due in 5 business days. Upload slides to shared drive: https://redwood.example.com/drive/QBR-MDF-2026

jamal: Upload a simple sim like this so finance can sign off:```csv
month,committed_legacy,si_onboard,marketplace_promo,open_pool,total
May,30000,20000,10000,40000,100000
Jun,30000,25000,10000,35000,100000
Jul,30000,20000,15000,35000,100000
```

tony: I'll run a SI adoption sensitivity with partner success — what if SI onboarding consumes 40% in month 2? We need an overflow policy (auto-approve from open_pool or pause marketplace promos).

maria: Overflow policy: primary = auto-pull from Open Pool up to 15% of total, secondary = manual approval by Partner Ops + Finance for anything above. That keeps velocity but prevents surprises.

liz: Action items:
- @jamal: create consolidated 6-month budget sim with scenarios (base / si-heavy / promo-heavy) — due EOD Thursday
- @tony: list top-10 legacy commitments and minimum guarantees — due Tue
- @maria: draft gating checklist for SI onboarding (training slots, POC success metric, integration SLA) — due Wed
- @kevin: confirm with Sales that tagged sub-pool language is acceptable — due Wed

kevin: will confirm with sales. Quick Q: does the gating checklist include a mandatory security review for on-prem SI installs?

maria: Yes — include security review (security@redwood sign-off) for any on-prem or private deployments before credits are released.

liz: Good. One more ask — can Partner Ops produce a short paragraph for the QBR slide that explains the merger rationale and guardrails? Keep it <2 sentences.

maria: Draft: "We consolidated MDF into a single pool to increase allocation flexibility across Marketplace and SI channels while preserving reserved capacity for legacy partner commitments and SI onboarding. Automated overflow and finance gating protect runway and control spend."

liz: Perfect. I'll paste that into the deck. Thanks team — follow-ups in thread. :rocket:
